head: e0d72d80

failures.test: mqtt.bridge.outbound_tests.test.outbound bridge does not extend expiry across target reconnect
failures.summary: A black-hole target CONNACK wait is not pausable, so the source keepalive lapses and the broker retires the source transport.

failures.test: quic.endpoint_server.tests.test.QUIC endpoint server routes two authenticated connections on one socket
failures.summary: The server observes only one of two client connection-ID retirements and times out with 'stage=retirements count=1'. The clients report no error, so one retirement never reaches the server's receive loop. Reproduced on 6e341c27 before the recent HTTP work; giving the retirement phase its own 15 s budget did not change the failure rate (3/6), so it is a genuine stall rather than an exhausted shared timer.

notes: Both failures are pre-existing and reproduce on commits that predate the HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 changes in this session. Every test covering the changed files passes: HTTP/2 973/973, HTTP/3 929/929, QUIC recovery 341/341, test-package 26/26.
